exercises.title: Count the vowels
exercises.prompt: Write Count(string text) in class Vowels: how many a, e, i, o, u (capitals count).

exercises.title: Savings goal
exercises.prompt: Write MonthsToGoal(int goal, int monthly) in class Goal with a while loop; -1 if monthly is 0 or less.
hints: int saved = 0, months = 0; while (saved < goal) { saved += monthly; months++; }
